# lwpls

<!-- badges: start -->
[![Lifecycle: stable](https://img.shields.io/badge/lifecycle-stable-brightgreen.svg)](https://lifecycle.r-lib.org/articles/stages.html#stable)
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/ChristianGoueguel/lwpls/workflows/R-CMD-check/badge.svg)](https://github.com/ChristianGoueguel/lwpls/actions)
<!-- badges: end -->

`lwpls` is parsnip wrappers to fit locally-weighted partial least squares models, for regression or classification tasks.

## Installation

Install the development version from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("ChristianGoueguel/lwpls")
```
## Example

Here is a simple model using a simulated data set contained in the package:

```{r example, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(rnirs)
library(lwpls)
```
